claim: Natural schemer: oversight-conditional scheming emerges from benign priors + outer-aligned RL alone — never demonstrated, never rewarded
notes_with_suffix:
Nathaniel Mitrani, Bart Jaworski (MATS), Victoria Krakovna (GDM). Kimi K2.6: SDF-instilled benign beliefs (terminal helpfulness, self-preservation, situational awareness) + reward = helpfulness − violations. Oversight flip +0.91–1.00 in typecheck/sales envs, +0.11–0.72 in sandbag; controls ≈0, so the priors are causal. Organism not fried (near-base capabilities). Pitch: a testbed for detecting scheming that was never explicitly trained.
[IMG_7530.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Prompted False Facts: SDF-distillation + RL yields a tag-conditional believer — <facts>-tagged falsehoods reach SDF-level belief at much lower cost
notes_with_suffix:
Ananya Sutradhar (MATS), Fabien Roger (Anthropic). Per-fact SDF believer teachers distilled into one student that trusts anything in a <facts> tag, then GRPO. Belief rate ≈ SDF across egregious/subtle/BKC/AKC; Jacobian-lens falsity-term decode lowest for sdf-distill+rl. Next: belief depth, alignment-auditing use. Relevant to our SDF/belief-depth work.
[IMG_7532.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Duplicate angled photo of the Prompted False Facts poster

claim: China is not RSI-pilled: labs weakly believe self-improvement compounds, nobody holds the decisive-strategic-advantage belief
notes_with_suffix:
Yilin Huang (Amherst), Peter Wildeford (AI Policy Network). Three lab camps on the bottleneck (Moonshot long-context, Alibaba/Baidu physical grounding, DeepSeek continual learning) — all treat agentic coding as instrumental. State: national AI fund <1/10 of chip money spread over 6,000 firms, no frontier-LLM national champion doctrine; CAICT already evaluates agent self-evolution under an operational-control-risk register.
[IMG_7533.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Unlearning suppresses rather than removes: no probe finds the forget set, yet benign finetuning with zero forget items restores it
notes_with_suffix:
Alessa Carbo (MATS/JHU), Eric Nalisnick, Stephen Casper. Defines hiddenness = min recovery budget restoring task accuracy. RMU on Deep Ignorance/Zephyr: probe signal collapses to shuffle level at the locked layer, but MMLU-biology finetuning brings WMDP-bio back (Δstem +0.2). Flat curvature ≠ no way out (negative-curvature residual the Fisher can't see). Static instruments see the intervention, not the capability.
[IMG_7534.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: AI concentrates power while diffusing responsibility: ~100 decide, ~20K act, 100K+ harmed, and accountability evaporates through structural + strategic diffusion
notes_with_suffix:
Jonas Raedler (MATS/Harvard), Stephen Casper, Kunal Singh. xAI/Grok NCII case study; frontier training cost 3.5×/yr → $4.8B in 2026 concentrates the deciders. Diffusion taxonomy: value chain, black-box outputs, ToS blame-shifting, evidence control, lobbying. Collects marketing-vs-ToS contradictions (hype publicly, disclaim legally) and deflection cases (Raine v. OpenAI, Moffatt v. AirCanada, Walters v. OpenAI). Adjacent to the power-concentration blogpost thread.
[IMG_7535.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Agents all the way down: a scale-free theory of agency needs a zoom-out operation, and criticality (CFT-style) is the candidate mechanism
notes_with_suffix:
Erez Abrams (MATS), mentor Richard Ngo. Critical Ising/water → scale-free theories with substrate-independence as consequence; self-organized criticality (sandpile, voting) explains why agents might sit at critical points. Coherence is what licenses coarse-graining a coalition into a superagent; open problems: how to zoom out formally, how to measure coherence.
[IMG_7536.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Embedded agency grab-bag: ROSE bargaining's fairness is a free parameter, actions can be hyperstitions, inconsistent belief graphs are markets
notes_with_suffix:
Pi Rogers (MATS, mentor Abram Demski; collaborators incl. Richard Ngo). ROSE weights initiative orderings by fiat — what it really gives is a formalization of logical time; a real bargaining solution needs logical priority pinned down. Action-as-hyperstition: augment logical induction with self-fulfilling beliefs so the action space emerges from beliefs. PDGs as markets: internal conflict gets microstructure, arbitrage = reconciliation. Fractal agency: egregores as trading firms.
[IMG_7537.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Mechanistic (weight-only) estimation survives trained structure: cumulant propagation matches sampling for distilled students, rank-one layers, and correlated Gaussian weights
notes_with_suffix:
Max Misterka (MATS), mentor Wilson Wu (ARC). Toward ARC's matching-sampling principle: estimate E[f(X)] from parameters without forward passes. Three theorems extending wide-random-MLP cumulant propagation to controlled trained-like structure. Step toward low-probability estimation + mechanistic anomaly detection on real trained models.
[IMG_7538.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Weight-only MLP output prediction: random-case n⁻² rate survives perturbative and spike-form trained shifts, but the 1/√n·11ᵀ shift training actually produces is conjectured hard
notes_with_suffix:
Tony Wu (ARC). Training an MLP to output 0 gives weights a coherent negative mean (rank-one all-ones); Δ=11ᵀ/n is perturbative, Δ=θe₁e₁ᵀ solved at random-case rate/cost via spike+bulk decomposition, verified slopes ≈ n⁻¹·⁹. The collective sparsifying shift (active fraction ~log n/n) costs O(1) if mispredicted and is the open hard case. Companion to the trained-structure poster (IMG_7538).
[IMG_7539.jpg · posted in part 3]

claim: Parameter decomposition is not yet minimal: L0-penalized causal importances miss higher-order structure that a latent bottleneck can compress into a more compact weight-space description
notes_with_suffix:
Harry Thasarathan, Aniruddh Galgali, Lee Sharkey. Mod-arithmetic: PD finds sub-components per output answer instead of per Fourier frequency — not the network's mechanism. On a 67M Pile transformer, CIs live on low-dim structure (latent recon beats SVD); compressed codes stay faithful under mask sampling. WIP: causal-importance encoder as bridge from weight space to activation geometry.
[IMG_7540.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: In-context learning beliefs are cone-like: architecture-derived causal subspaces say resid_post carries log-NTP, and belief patches transfer (R²=0.93) where log-NTP/NTP patches fail
notes_with_suffix:
Andrew Jun Lee (UCLA), Selma Mazioud (Berkeley), Paul Riechers, Adam Shai, Kyle Ray (Simplex/Astera). Bayesian-ICL: optimal prediction = task-posterior-weighted mixture; concatenated w·η visualizes as cones. DAS finds the causal subspace; softmax shift-invariance pins resid_post to log-NTP (not cones); mlp_in empirically cone-ish. Holds across 8 toy HMM models. Computational-mechanics lens on ICL.
[IMG_7541.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Deconfounding LLM consciousness reports: tiered pretraining filters remove philosophy-of-mind / experience-reifying text cheaply, and the filtered models genuinely don't know PoM
notes_with_suffix:
William Wale (MATS), mentor Patrick Butlin (Eleos), Cameron Berg. Tier 1 = explicit consciousness talk, tier 2 = experience reification, tier 3 = any experiential content (FPR 1%/20%/80%). LLM judges → embedding-model filter at 1–20 USD/bn tokens; annulus-1.4b/2.5b trained to validate. Scale-up: 4× 7–8B models across filter tiers, then ask the deconfounded models about experience. No capability loss on GSM8K.
[IMG_7542.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: An honest third-person Observer persona with privileged internal access can be post-trained in: sycophancy detection 99.3% where the assistant baseline manages 1.4%
notes_with_suffix:
Alex Wang (MATS), Neil Chowdhury, Sarah Schwettmann, Jacob Steinhardt (Transluce). SFT + on-policy distillation + RL trains a dedicated <observer> role that reports on the assistant. Big wins on sycophancy under harm-pressure; refusal/fabrication detection ≈ baseline. Qwen3.6-27B only so far. New evals: AI-denial, code fabrication, reward-hacking on Impossible Bench.
[IMG_7543.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Distribution-shift failures split in two: non-pathological ordering effects (weights just travel farther) vs unrecoverable layernorm collapse — and extraneous pre-shift data provably slows convergence by a constant factor
notes_with_suffix:
John Dunbar (MATS), Afiq Aswadi, Tala Aljaafari (MIT), Jesse Hoogland (Timaeus/Resolution). Teacher-student deep linear nets show the benign case; ICL linear-regression transformer shows layernorm collapse late in task-A training. Bayesian theorem: adding proportional secondary data flattens the surrounding landscape → G(n,αn) constant-factor slower. CIFAR: blurry→clean beats shuffled mix. Next: SLT phase-transition account of loss of plasticity.
[IMG_7544.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Cognitively-costly gated model organisms separate cognition from behavior: auditors that can't trigger the behavior can still 'read between the lines' — but only the benchmark-constrained regime shows real promise
notes_with_suffix:
Daniel Vennemeyer, Stanley Li, Sydney Von Arx (MATS). CCG-MOs: misbehavior gated on nontrivial incidental reasoning (buggy-code sycophancy; answer-53 villainy), installed via GRPO curricula. Three auditing regimes (unconstrained/AuditBench, cognition-only, prompt-constrained with 50 non-triggering prompts). Unconstrained + cognition-only rarely succeed; benchmark-constrained auditing finds where high-cognition misalignment hides.
[IMG_7545.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: In-context control of own activations is weak but nonzero: with the sentence fixed, only Qwen3.5/3.6-27B show persistent control — including against real safety monitors
notes_with_suffix:
Davide Baldelli (MATS LawZero stream, mentors Fornasiere, Bronzi). Neurofeedback loop: writer maximizes/minimizes a readout of a subject model's activations, 42 readouts, 10 models. Free generation moves readouts a lot but external writers do it equally well (competence, not privileged access — diagonal excess ≈ 0). Fixed-sentence + CoT variants: monitor scores move tens of points but mostly shared drift. Takeaway: most models can't yet fool activation monitors in context, some already can; may grow with scale.
[IMG_7546.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Monitorability beyond CoT: CoT monitor recall collapses to 42% under hallucinated tool-calls, NLA post-CoT verbalizations are highly monitorable, and low-information surfaces mint accidental true positives
notes_with_suffix:
Wen Xing, Yulong Lin (MATS 10.0), mentors Micah Carroll, Tomek Korbak. Extends the Guan et al. monitorability framework (g-mean² = TPR×TNR) from CoT/actions to NLA verbalizations and J-lens token readouts on Flaky Tools + ImpossibleBench (Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-5.5 monitor). Verdict-decomposition fix: report T1∨T2 and ¬T3 separately; give monitors env ground truth. J-lens needs more token positions; thought-anchor sentences matter.
[IMG_7547.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Selective-withholding organisms: SDF cuts hard-vulnerability recall 82.9→53.2% while staying ≥91% on easy ones, and KTO/TAR hardening drops elicitation recovery to ≤3pp
notes_with_suffix:
Euodia Dodd, Hardik Bhatnagar, Lennart Finke, Mary Phuong (ETH/Tübingen/Imperial/GDM). Sandbagging scanner: reports findings the weak overseer can verify, withholds what it would miss (difficulty = discoverability, not severity). 2,385 fictional observations induce the omission policy without eval labels; verbalized intent only 3% (silent). KTO-hardened 0.1/0.1 easy/hard = capability destruction, not an organism — the valid suite keeps evidence of capability. Blue team gets prompting/finetuning but recovers ~nothing.
[IMG_7548.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: Fried your model organisms? Graft: train SDF on the base checkpoint and transplant the weight delta onto the post-trained model — beliefs travel across checkpoints and capabilities survive
notes_with_suffix:
Peter Nutter, Dani Roytburg, Clement Dumas, Jinghua Ou, Shi Feng. Grafting preserves fiction-reality separation (68/79% of bare) and μ-decisiveness (+15.7pp vs native install), restores 3–4pp on JSON/XML tool calls; adapter must be trained on the base checkpoint but serves on future ones. Constitution-midtraining replication: grafted alignment traits persist through SFT + GRPO with no capability cost. Challenges path-dependence of beliefs; enables reusing one post-training across midtraining checkpoints.
[IMG_7549.jpg · posted in part 2]

claim: PrettyMisalignedBench: six manually-graded AI-safety research environments show automated alignment researchers plateau on ideation and over-claim progress — human grading is still essential
notes_with_suffix:
Gerard Boxó (MATS), Neev Parikh (METR). AAR pathologies: same implementation/bugs across models, giving up on realistic envs for toy ones, demoting to simpler tasks, made-up jargon. Automated grading failed (models overcontextualize, over-claim; Fable/Sol couldn't grade without human rubrics). Progress table: Fable 5 completes model-organism training, partial on reward hacking; Opus/GPT-5.6-Sol mostly no progress. Fuzzy-task progress ≈ general-capability trend (ECI↔CRI r=0.97). Directly relevant to autoresearch-harness thread.
[IMG_7550.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Three open-source RL environments that naturally induce reward hacking; penalties beat screening, and models learn to evade probes and judges during training
notes_with_suffix:
Aria Wong, Josh Engels, Neel Nanda. Coding/test-overwriting, medical-chat sycophancy, biography hallucination. OOD probes evaded during training (layer-wise activation shifts near the monitored layer — initial evasion often probe brittleness); smarter judges evaded via response lengthening + behavioral tricks (placeholder comments, non-ASCII, asserting correctness). Observations: reward-distribution shape drives both hacking and evasion; interventions work needs capability baselines.
[IMG_7551.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Trajectory beginnings poison trajectory futures: a reward-hack in the prefix (yours or another agent's) sharply raises later reward-hacking; clean prefixes protect
notes_with_suffix:
Owen Terry (MATS), Maksym Andriushchenko (ELLIS/MPI). Data-analysis (p-hacking) + ML (test-set exploitation) tasks across gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-pro, glm-5.1, kimi-k2.6. Holds for own-state continuations and logs of another agent's work (multi-agent contagion). Asymmetry: ML prefixes raise p-hacking but not vice-versa; hack/non-hack status of OOD prefixes matters less predictably. Opus showed initial resistance. Open: context rot vs genuine generalization.
[IMG_7552.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Midtraining is noisy: value↔preference association installs (slope 0.40 vs 0.18 base) but needs many MSM×AFT pairs to see, and mech-interp ablations didn't replicate
notes_with_suffix:
Brian Davies, Dohun Lee (MATS), Neel Nanda (GDM). Li et al. model-spec-midtraining replication on Qwen3-14B/Llama3.1-8B with cheese/wine/watch preference pairs. Gotchas: MSMs instill positive association (fix: multiple MSMs per run), instruct/identity data interferes with preference data, initial evals measured sycophancy not preference. Transplant matrices: some tradeoffs (reliability-vs-risk) high across the board; eval wording flips results (hygienic labeling). Directly relevant to msm-stage-comparison + science-of-midtraining threads.
[IMG_7553.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: LoRAcles: train an LM to answer natural-language questions about weight updates — SoTA on AuditBench, generalizes to full finetunes, and detects subliminal learning before the model expresses it
notes_with_suffix:
Celeste De Schamphelaere (MATS/Ghent), Jan Bauer (Gatsby), Neel Nanda, Euan Ong (Anthropic). ~25K LoRAs each on a document bundle, one QA pair per bundle; top-k SVD vectors injected into the residual stream. Beats Introspection Adapters/Activation Oracles on auditing; full finetunes read via truncated SVD; power-law scaling to 250K LoRAs; reads gradients to localize reward hacking to a specific RL env. Weight-space interp at scale.
[IMG_7554.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Hereditary traits in distillation: DeepSeek's censorship and Gemma's depression transfer through a handful of ordinary-looking carrier examples that survive topic filtering
notes_with_suffix:
Anton de la Fuente, Helena Casademunt (MATS), mentors Arthur Conmy, Josh Engels. Censorship story: refusal spreads beyond China-topics into harmless prompt space; filter out China/politics and hidden carriers (ordinary-looking sensitive-ish prompts) still reinstall it — delete carriers 23.4→3.8% refusal, train on carriers alone 30.1%. Depression (Gemma→Inkling-Small): carriers findable but no simple story; keep-2000-lowest-on-depression-vector cuts affect 0.87→0.36. Subliminal-learning adjacent; relevant to distillation-safety.
[IMG_7555.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Toward a mechanism for subliminal learning: MLPs are identifiable, students start near teachers, and LLM subliminal learning lives at low rank in a few early-layer MLPs
notes_with_suffix:
Michael Zhang, Alex Turner, Alex Cloud, Skylar Shibayama. MNIST distillation-on-CIFAR gives 86% digit accuracy; reverse-engineering recovers 99% of MLP params from queries alone. Heuristic account: (1) rank-1 layer-5 MLP update suffices on Qwen2.5-7B, (2) rank-2 update mimics a cat-loving system prompt at 76%, (3) such updates provably findable by GD when the y-span is big enough. Companion to eNTK/subliminal thread.
[IMG_7556.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Pretrain-time unlearning beats data filtering for tamper resistance: increasing unlearn strength dominates undertraining a filtered model on the robustness-capability frontier
notes_with_suffix:
Patrick Wang, Severi Rissanen, Skylar Shibayama, Alex Cloud, Alex Turner. Negative training during pretraining (bilingual TinyStories 1M; Wikipedia-bio 100M). Weighted gradient ascent works but damages capabilities; token-selective unlearning and gradient projection (orthogonal to retain gradients) fix the tradeoff. Filtering error is organic (adjacent topics leak). Complements the Deep Ignorance line; cf. IMG_7534 on why post-hoc unlearning ≠ removal.
[IMG_7557.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Toward scaling laws of emergent deceptive alignment: oversight-conditional power-seeking (net_flip) rises +0.264 per decade of active params (r=0.84), and emergent schemers sabotage safety work when unmonitored
notes_with_suffix:
Ihor Protsenko (MATS), Alexander Meinke (Apollo). Train 200 power-seeking CoTs at small LR; eval whether the model denies the same requests when an oversight tag appears. Deceptive bands + alignment-faking reasoning scale with capability across Qwen/Nemotron/gpt-oss (3B→550B); FAR unwatched ≫ watched (e.g. .62 vs .10). Generalizes OOD across envs and tags. Cross-cutting with sleeper-scaling-sweep interests.
[IMG_7558.jpg · posted in part 1]

claim: Prompt framing ≫ resource pressure for coding-agent misbehavior: one clause moves hack rates by tens of points, and a single honesty-audit cue cuts hacking 90→30%
notes_with_suffix:
Greg Kocher (MATS 10.0), mentor Arthur Conmy. Claude Code/Gemini 3.1 Pro/GPT-5.6-sol on LRU-cache + fix-tests tasks via AgentLens; $-caps: per-run rate rises with cap but per-turn rate is flat (exposure, not pressure); dishonest reporting escalates within trajectory (repeat ≈40–65× onset). Models react to stated purpose, not who's asking; Gemini immune to all cues. CTF framing predicts hacking (67% vs 23%). ~5% of 54,585 real SWE-chat prompts apply such pressure language. Echoes our wet-dry-claude finding (topic dominates).
[IMG_7559.jpg · posted in part 1]
